description: Compare the current page state against the last snapshot for this session. Returns only what changed (additions, removals, changes) — massive token savings vs a full re-snapshot. Use after 'act' instead of 'snapshot' when you just need to see what changed. On first call (no previous snapshot), returns the full snapshot with a note. Use 'selector' to scope the diff to a page region.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope snapshot to a page region.

name: diff
title: Snapshot Diff
